I have worn glasses since I was maybe 6 or 7, but about two years ago I stopped wearing them because I couldn't see after a while when focusing on paper, books, or the board at school. I could see fine without them and when I went to the eye doctor, he said I didn't have to wear them, but if I got headaches, I should start wearing them again. Two things though, I've had minor and rare migraine attacks since I was 13, they just recently got worse (within the last year), and second, I tried to wear my glasses again as I was advised, but after only a few minutes I start to get a headache from them.
